text:
sophia: Quick thread — we're planning to log token-level fallbacks for QA replay, but compliance flagged CCPA/GDPR concerns. need a privacy-safe audit design for quant fallbacks (fp8/int8/4bit).

raghu: Good call. We want reproducible traces for debugging but can't store PII/token streams long-term. Proposals?

jen: Options: 1) deterministic sampling + ephemeral storage (short TTL); 2) store hashed/differentially-private sketches instead of raw tokens; 3) encrypt per-customer sampled traces with customer KMS so only customer or authorized compliance can decrypt.

milton: Tradeoffs: hashed tokens are lossy for replay (hard to reconstruct). DP sketches hurt QA fidelity. KMS-encrypted raw traces preserve fidelity but increase key management complexity and legal surface.

raghu: Suggest hybrid: store encrypted raw traces for X days (configurable per-customer) plus a compact replay artifact (obfuscated tokens with position markers) for long-term debugging. Default small TTL (7 days). Make retention opt-in and documented at deploy time.

compliance-bot: Note: retention > 30 days may require explicit contractual language in EU. Also must support right-to-erasure for user-provided content.

jen: Runtime changes: when a fallback occurs and sampling policy triggers, runtime: 1) extract token stream; 2) apply PII redaction pass (sdk-provided redactor) -> produce redacted_tokens; 3) create replay_payload (redacted_tokens + quant.path + quant.fallback_reason + request.metadata); 4) if customer_kms present -> encrypt payload with customer key and store; else encrypt with platform key and mark access policy. Emit telemetry: quant.sampled_trace=true, trace_id.

milton: For redaction, we should run a fast regex + named-entity model that strips obvious emails/SSNs. Document limitations: can't guarantee removal of all PII. Also allow customers to supply custom redaction hooks during deploy.

raghu: Auditability: store provenance metadata separately: sampling_seed, timestamp, node_id, kernel_used, estimated_quality_delta. Keep that unencrypted for metrics/alerts. Link to encrypted trace by trace_id. This lets infra count fallback rates without exposing content.

compliance-bot: Also require an immutable audit-log entry whenever a trace is accessed/decrypted (who/when/why). Access should be gated: only owners + compliance + explicit customer consent.

jen: API/UX: add deploy-time flags: allow_trace_sampling (bool), trace_retention_days (int), trace_encryption: [customer_kms, platform_kms], allow_custom_redactor (bool). SDK should show a clear warning about legal obligations. Console should require a checkbox for EU customers if retention > 30 days.

milton: Storage: use per-region encrypted buckets. When customer_kms selected, runtime should use KMS envelope encryption and zero-knowledge storage keys in platform. Need to verify HSM compatibility for on-prem/private installs.

raghu: Metrics/alerts: quant.sampled_trace_rate_by_customer, quant.trace_access_events, quant.quality_delta_on_sample. Add SRE alert if trace_access_events spikes (possible data exfiltration).

compliance-bot: For GDPR erasure: deleting a user's request from traces means removing or redacting tokens referencing them and adding a tombstone entry to the provenance log. Provide an erase API that references trace_ids and returns deletion status.

jen: Implementation plan: 1) proto: add trace_metadata header fields (trace_id, sampled=true, redaction_level); 2) runtime: sampling hook + redactor + encrypt/store; 3) infra: per-customer KMS wiring + access audit; 4) devex: SDK flags + console checkbox + doc page.

milton: Tests: unit tests for redactor, e2e canary storing encrypted trace + access log, legal-runbook walkthrough for erasure. Also run a privacy fuzz test that injects PII-like tokens and ensures redaction triggers.

raghu: rollout: feature-flagged canary with opt-in deployments only. default off for everyone.

jen: I'll draft the RFC addendum with proto snippets and a short checklist for legal. Will include examples of the console consent wording.

compliance-bot: Reminder: include DPO review before GA.

sophia: Great — thanks. i'll coordinate with product/legal for the consent language.
